title: angelica maritima
intro: Angelica maritima, commonly known as sea angelica, is a perennial plant species within the angelica genus, which belongs to the carrot family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of sea angelica are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce spasms, and exhibit expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Angelica maritima include coumarins, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
